title: 2.2 Welcome Name
prompt: 2.2 Write a program that uses input to prompt a user for their name and then welcomes them. For example, if the name entered is Sarah, the output should be: Hello Sarah.

student.py.starter:
# The code below almost works

name = input("Enter your name")
print("Howdy")
student.py.solution:
name = input("Enter your name: ")
print("Hello", name)
